verdict.rationale: Granola documents a RESTful API that gives programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts and AI summaries. Users create their own API keys and choose note-access scopes, and workspace admins can create non-expiring workspace keys, so a script can pull transcripts and summaries across meetings. Action items are not a documented API field, though: the docs only suggest a script could extract them from notes. Coverage of the full story is therefore partial. Missing for 10: action items as a documented structured API output, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec (probed spec paths returned 404), clear documentation that non-Business/Enterprise users can create self-serve keys covering every meeting, and independent hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my scripts can pull transcripts, summaries, and action items from every meeting through a documented API with self-serve keys

citations.quote: The Granola API lets you build custom integrations with programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries.
This RESTful API enables you to integrate Granola with your existing tools
When you create an API key, you choose which note access scopes it should include.
Workspace admins on Business and Enterprise plans can also create workspace API keys.
Extract action items from meeting notes and automatically create tasks in Linear, Jira, Todoist, or your project management tool of choice.
